payload.source_text: Party-wide magical damage that also summons adds. Keep the boss away from the adds and kill them quickly, as they can give the boss buffs at close range. The first time, summons 2 Frozen Knight melee adds (red weapons). Red enemies cast Rictus, a circle AoE around themselves that will give the boss a stacking File:Damage up icon2.png Damage Up if he touches it. Red adds can also cast Overturn (large cone AoE); Iron Tempest (large circle AoE), Dead Alive (makes the add deal critical hits for 10 seconds), and Widowmaker (strong but small cone AoE). The second time, summons 2 Frozen Chirurgeon caster adds (blue weapons). Blue enemies cast Lifeless Wind, a circle AoE around themselves that will give the boss a stacking haste Haste buff if he touches it. Blue adds can also cast Blizzard (circle AoE), Black Eruption (circle AoE that inflicts Heavy Heavy), and Dark Blizzard III (circle AoE that inflicts Bind Bind) The third time, summons 2 melee adds and 2 caster adds.

Large donut-shaped AoE, usually cast right after summoning adds.

Telegraphed line AoE at a random player.

an attack similar to Shiva's ground freeze - when the ground is frozen, you will move a certain length in the direction you attempt to go. Unlike Shiva, this is not all the way to the edge of the arena; it is a matter of several yalms. At that point it will always be active when it casts Disclosure.
A random player gets tethered to the boss; it will shortly charge at them; the player has to run far away from the boss.

Spawns a set of circles for resolving upcoming mechanics. White circle: While standing in it, grants Levitation to resolve Quakes. Black circle: While standing in it, inflicts Leaden to resolve Tornados. Green circle: Toggles imp status. If you are not an imp, inflicts 20s of Imp and Lightning Resistance Down II; if you are, cleanses those debuffs. Imps cannot use any actions.
Targets a random player and starts casting a conal AoE in front of the boss aimed at the player.

Spawns ghosts of the players at their current positions that occasionally cast Enthrallment. See the ability below. Players should look at the walls of the arena to avoid AoEs in the center of the arena.

Spawns ghosts of the players at their current positions that occasionally cast Enthrallment. See the ability below. Players should look at the walls of the arena to avoid AoEs in the center of the arena.

Targets a random player and creates a toxic cloud that tethers to them. If the toxic cloud reaches the player, it explodes, inflicting a stack of Vulnerability Up, dealing damage, and creates a puddle on the ground that inflicts Pollen to players inside of it. If targeted, run around the arena until the cloud dissipates.
The spawned ghosts from Neura Squamae cast a frontal cone AoE where the players were looking when it was cast.
The spawned ghosts from Neura Squamae cast a frontal cone AoE where the players were looking when it was cast.

Targets a random area with a large circular AoE. After the AoE explodes, a wind orb will be left on the battlefield that will slowly grow upwards, increasing the damage it deals before it explodes, dealing massive damage to each player. A player should step in it to make it explode prematurely, dealing moderate damage; after Ancient Libra is cast at least once, this should be assigned to a player with Earth Resistance Down II to minimize damage.

Targets 2 players with circular AoEs. Works the same as Ancient Aero; after Ancient Libra is cast at least once, the duty of popping the stone orb should be assigned to a player with Wind Resistance Down II to minimize damage.

Winged Lion lifts into the air, becomes untargetable, and casts a circular AoE. An Arcane Sphere spawns on the ground that grows upwards over time before it explodes at the end of the cast, similar to Ancient Aero and Ancient Stone, dealing massive damage to all players. It should be killed immediately. From the second cast onwards, Amdapori Gargoyle adds will spawn; the Sphere is top priority, adds can be ignored until after the Sphere is gone.

Winged Lion lifts into the air, becomes untargetable, and casts a circular AoE. An Arcane Sphere spawns on the ground that grows upwards over time before it explodes at the end of the cast, similar to Ancient Aero and Ancient Stone, dealing massive damage to all players. Frontal Cone AoE aimed at the Tank.
Proximity AoE based at Kuribu's location. Edges of the arena are the safest spots.
Marks two players with large red ring AoEs; spread out to reduce damage taken.
Marks two players with large red ring AoEs; spread out to reduce damage taken.

Spawns one of two adds depending on if the Reverse effect is active: a Low Putto with the Reverse effect active, which tethers to a player and inflicts Bleeding, Prey, and File:Healing potency down icon1.png Healing Potency Down, or a High Putto with no Reverse effect, which tethers to the boss and heals her. Both take priority over Kuribu.

Spawns one of two adds depending on if the Reverse effect is active: a Low Putto with the Reverse effect active, which tethers to a player and inflicts Bleeding, Prey, and File:Healing potency down icon1.png Healing Potency Down, or a High Putto with no Reverse effect, which tethers to the boss and heals her. Both take priority over Kuribu.
he jumps up and summons adds, including a turret
an add tethered to the boss or turret, kill asap
an add tethered to the boss or turret, kill asap
targets random player with aoe, spread out
targets barrier and spawns windy aoe
resolves to either a stack marker or a spread marker
resolves to either a stack marker or a spread marker
he summons untargetable Garuda, she fires a room wide aoe with some safe areas and marks everyone with green crystals and aoe rings, spread out
he summons untargetable Garuda, she fires a room wide aoe with some safe areas and marks everyone with green crystals and aoe rings, spread out
Line AoE stretching in front and behind Magitek Scorpion.

Knocks players back and applies Out of Body. Each player must slowly return to their physical body in the middle of the arena, linked by a fiery line. Prototype Death Claws will spawn and slowly follow each player, stunning at melee range, while Prototype Bits spawn around the area and shoot line AoEs, also stunning on contact. Avoiding both should be prioritized over rushing, though taking too long will result in death. After a player recovers their body, they can proceed to attack the Death Claws.

Knocks players back and applies Out of Body. Each player must slowly return to their physical body in the middle of the arena, linked by a fiery line. Prototype Death Claws will spawn and slowly follow each player, stunning at melee range, while Prototype Bits spawn around the area and shoot line AoEs, also stunning on contact. Avoiding both should be prioritized over rushing, though taking too long will result in death. After a player recovers their body, they can proceed to attack the Death Claws.
Line AoE targeted at each player. Do not stack or you will get hit by more than one ray.

Places 4 copies around Zenos. Large PBAoE around Zenos, followed by large PBAoEs around the copies. The AoEs of the copies do not overlap near Zenos. Zenos will jump one player and tether to them. After a few seconds he will execute Lightless Spark.
Cone AoE targeted at a chosen player.
Frontal cone AoE. Tank to dodge as required.

Galura will tether an off-aggro target and channel a straight line charge. Marked players should distances themselves from Galura to reduce damage taken, indicated when the tether turns from spiky pink to purple. Other players should move out of Galura's path.

Occurs immediately after Magnetism. A circle AoE will appear in the center, followed by a circle AoE covering the remainder of the outer arena. Stand just outside the inner AoE facing away from the Hunter of Bardam. Wait for the inner AoE to cast, then immediately walk backwards to avoid the outer AoE. If you use Legacy camera, press all 3 of left strafe, right strafe, and backwards in order to walk backwards, e.g. ASD if using WASD movement.
Throwing Spears appear along the edge of the map and fire off telegraphed AoEs that makes the map a crisscross of line AoEs.
Throwing Spears appear along the edge of the map and fire off telegraphed AoEs that makes the map a crisscross of line AoEs.
Three towers will spawn, 120 degrees from each other. One missed tower will give each player a strike, and two or more missed towers will cause the fight to reset.
Three towers will spawn, 120 degrees from each other. One missed tower will give each player a strike, and two or more missed towers will cause the fight to reset.

All players are marked and rings of fire drops periodically over their heads. Rings will remain active for a few seconds after dropping. To prevent dropping your AoE onto an ally's escape path, everyone should spread out and run clockwise.
Spawns 4 large circular AoEs that leaves behind Star Shards (rocks) to be used in the next phase. Safe spots include the center and the outer edge of the arena.
Spawns 4 large circular AoEs that leaves behind Star Shards (rocks) to be used in the next phase. Safe spots include the center and the outer edge of the arena.
Spawns 4 large circular AoEs that leaves behind Star Shards (rocks) to be used in the next phase. Safe spots include the center and the outer edge of the arena.
Spawns a Looming Shadow meteor circle with a lengthy period of time before it falls.
Breaks the east and west Star Shards with telegraphed circle AoEs, summoning two Warriors of Bardam at their location.
Breaks the east and west Star Shards with telegraphed circle AoEs, summoning two Warriors of Bardam at their location.

Dodge the AoE combinations by standing in the triangular regions formed by the intersections of the two red telegraphs, then moving into the donut AoE when it resolves. Will destroy one of the two remaining star shards. After these attacks, the meteor will land. Hide behind the last star shard.
Group-wide AoE. Spawns a number of orbs around the outer edge of the arena. Orbs will periodically fire line AoEs.
Group-wide AoE. Spawns a number of orbs around the outer edge of the arena. Orbs will periodically fire line AoEs.
Group-wide AoE. Spawns a number of orbs around the outer edge of the arena. Orbs will periodically fire line AoEs.
Marks a player with a green marker. The marked player will be knocked to the outer edge of the arena. Get back to the center of the arena to avoid outer AoEs.
Targeted Circle AoE

Rushes around the room in line patterns. During this attack, two 12th Legion Optio adds will spawn and activate the cannons on the sides of the arena, bombarding random players with avoidable AoEs. Defeat the adds to commandeer their cannons and use its ability on Magna Roader to disrupt this attack. This attack will continue indefinitely until Magna Roader is hit with a cannon shot. Be warned that the Magna Roader cannot be harmed while it is speeding across the arena - wait for it to pause before firing.

Discrete Magick: Three telegraphed 120 degree conal AoEs Discrete Magick: Stack marker on random player (Fire II) Serial Magicks: Two sets of three conal AoEs, along with a stack marker on a random player

Discrete Magick: Telegraphed line AoE on each player (Sparking Current) Serial Magicks: Two sets of two opposite towers will spawn, along with telegraphed line AoEs on each player

Periodically, Inferno will move to the back of the arena and get showered by the magitek device there to empower his arms. Empowered Ketu: Adds a Bleeding debuff to the Tank. The second empower adds Vulnerability Up. Empowered Rahu: Adds a multi-column room-wide AoE and a proximity AoE. Second empower adds two player-targeted AoEs.

Two 12th Legion Death Claws and one 12th Legion Packer will spawn. The two Death Claws will tether to random players and will incapacitate them should they reach their tethered player. The Packer will slowly move towards the back of the arena and attempt to use Quick Charge on the device. If the Packer is able to complete Quick Charge, Inferno will immediately upgrade his arms further.

Two 12th Legion Death Claws and one 12th Legion Packer will spawn. The two Death Claws will tether to random players and will incapacitate them should they reach their tethered player. The Packer will slowly move towards the back of the arena and attempt to use Quick Charge on the device. If the Packer is able to complete Quick Charge, Inferno will immediately upgrade his arms further.

These will be lined up on the edge of the arena firing an unnamed attack for major damage. It's a narrow line across the arena, but occasionally ones next to each other will fire together for a wider beam.
- Stack marker on a random player.

A Hexadrone Bit will appear on the edge of the arena and erect a damaging red field across the arena, restricting the area you can safely move in. Standing within will cause it to deal damage and knockback.
A tower will appear; at least one player needs to stand in it to prevent moderate damage hitting the entire group.
Magitek Chakrams will appear around the edge of the arena, and use this to slice across the arena. Pay attention to where the chakram appear for some forewarning about where to dodge.
Watch for the message. Large line AoE front/behind the boss.

Summons 4 Tsumuji-kaze adds. Places moving whirlwinds around the area. Places clouds around the area. The clouds explode and knockback on touch. From time to time fiery lines will appear between the whirlwinds. The boss will charge along those lines with a much larger hitbox than the lines themselves. Getting hit will do moderate damage and apply 1 stack of Vulnerability Up. At the end of this phase, a proximity AoE (Reaper's Gale) will be dropped at one edge of the area. First thing the boss will do after is The Patient Blade.

Summons 4 Tsumuji-kaze adds. Places moving whirlwinds around the area. Places clouds around the area. The clouds explode and knockback on touch. From time to time fiery lines will appear between the whirlwinds. The boss will charge along those lines with a much larger hitbox than the lines themselves. Getting hit will do moderate damage and apply 1 stack of Vulnerability Up. At the end of this phase, a proximity AoE (Reaper's Gale) will be dropped at one edge of the area. First thing the boss will do after is The Patient Blade.
Uses Tornado. Damage is rather low. Adds seem to be melee in general.

Genbu jumps in the air, upon landing greenish light. Arrows appear on the hexagonal platforms, along with a blue orb. The orb will explode and send water following the arrows. Stand on a platform that is not in the water's path. Getting hit will result in moderate damage and 1 stack of Vulnerability Up.

Genbu becomes invincible and begins charging his Genbu's Focus meter. Destroy the Chelonian Gate around him before the meter fills completely. During this time platforms will start to glow and damage anyone standing on them, so move off of them quickly.

A player is marked with a cross marker. The boss then places a telegraphed AoE under them. When it goes off, a green pool spawns there, inflicting Pollen (poison) and Leaden on players while they are standing in it.

Stack marker on a random player. Devour: The Nullchu will leap to the Rafflesia's position and consume it. It will then turn towards the center of the arena and channel Odious Atmosphere, which deals damage every second a player stands in it and also inflicts cleansable Poison for 30s. The best way to avoid this is to stand near the Rafflesia, as the poison breath casts extremely quickly. Nullchu telegraphs this attack by turning to face the Rafflesia, with a notification of "The Nullchu has found its next meal!"
All players are targeted with AoEs, spread out to avoid overlapping damage.

The arena is covered in four "conveyor belt" line markers, and a few Silt Golem adds will spawn on the outside of the arena. When the cast completes, all players will be pushed in the direction of the arrows a distance roughly equivalent to half the arena. As players are being pushed, the Silt Golems will cast Rockslide, damaging in a line ahead of them and inflicting Vulnerability Up. Players should do their best to be pushed into a safe area, as there's little time to avoid Rockslide after being pushed.

All players are marked for an AoE. Spread out to avoid overlap, but also keep the center of the attack off the solid platforms. Allowing Quagmire to coat a platform creates a highly-damaging puddle on that platform that will also inflict a 50-second Vulnerability Up to anyone who steps in it.

All players are marked for an AoE. Spread out to avoid overlap, but also keep the center of the attack off the solid platforms. Allowing Quagmire to coat a platform creates a highly-damaging puddle on that platform that will also inflict a 50-second Vulnerability Up to anyone who steps in it.

Tokkapchi will move to the center of the arena and create a Mud Slime add. The add cannot be killed, only pushed via damage. Keep all of the boss's area of effect attacks away from the Mud Slime, including the periodic puddle explosion. Allowing the Mud Slime to be hit with attacks will cause it to grow, causing it to deal more damage when it finally detonates. After roughly 45 seconds, the Mud Slime will cast Corrupture, dealing damage to the entire party based on how large it became. If the Mud Slime was not allowed to grow at all, Corrupture instead only hits melee range. If the Mud Slime grows once, Corrupture will deal moderate party-wide damage. If the Mud Slime grows twice, it will explode immediately for very high damage while also inflicting a cleansable Damage Down.
Cone attack targeting the Mud Slime. Very long cast time to allow the players to push the Mud Slime away.
Ring area of effect that leaves melee range safe. If Tokkapchi is on the edge of the arena, the opposite side is also a safe area.

a telegraphed physical tankbuster. While the boss is casting Shuck, one of the boss's legs will become targetable. Destroying the leg interrupts the cast of Shuck, and also sends the boss tumbling onto its back for a several seconds, preventing it from performing any actions and inflicting Vulnerability Up. If the Kamikiri add is slain before Digest's cast completes, the cast is interrupted.-->
which will cause everyone hit by it to slowly walk toward the boss. Immediately after Seduce, the boss will perform Coriolis Kick, a large circular AoE, which Seduced players will be hit by.
which places a large circular AoE as well as marking two players with an AoE which will track them. Affected players should repeatedly run out of this effect, avoiding touching the boxes.

dealing group-wide damage, filling the arena with water and hiding the boss. Three Churn enemies (bubble adds) will spawn, each applying a stacking Dropsy debuff until they are killed. When all three Churns have been killed, Shisui Yohi will re-enter the battlefield.
Places an AoE marker on all players. Spread out to avoid damage overlap, but also position as to not hit any of the crystals.
Summons Rock Biters (chakrams) on the sides of the arena that launch across in a straight line after a short time. Simply don't stand in front of them.

Star-shaped AoE placed towards the south of the arena. There is an initial circular AoE at the landing point (though this may not be obvious from the telegraph). Then, four line AoEs will originate from it. Getting hit by any of these AoEs inflicts a vulnerability up Vulnerability Up stack and traps you in a block of ice called Mist for up to 10s. While trapped, you suffer from deep freeze Deep Freeze damage over time. The Mist is extremely brittle and can be attacked by others to free its trapped player. Later on in the fight, the boss will instead place 2 of these star-shaped AoEs in a randomly rotated but fixed pattern.

Star-shaped AoE placed towards the south of the arena. There is an initial circular AoE at the landing point (though this may not be obvious from the telegraph). Then, four line AoEs will originate from it. Getting hit by any of these AoEs inflicts a vulnerability up Vulnerability Up stack and traps you in a block of ice called Mist for up to 10s. While trapped, you suffer from deep freeze Deep Freeze damage over time. The Mist is extremely brittle and can be attacked by others to free its trapped player. Later on in the fight, the boss will instead place 2 of these star-shaped AoEs in a randomly rotated but fixed pattern.

The Mist Dragon turns into mist in the center of the arena. Three Draconic Regard adds will spawn and tether to the Mist Dragon. Attempting to attack the Mist Dragon in this form will cause it to counterattack, trapping you in an ice block.

The Mist Dragon turns into mist in the center of the arena. Three Draconic Regard adds will spawn and tether to the Mist Dragon. Attempting to attack the Mist Dragon in this form will cause it to counterattack, trapping you in an ice block.
An area of effect centered on the Mist Dragon's misty form that gradually expands. Slaying all of the Draconic Regard adds will prevent the attack's area from expanding further.

The arena becomes shrouded in thick fog that gives an indefinite dropsy Dropsy debuff, and the Mist Dragon leaves the arena. The Mist Dragon will spray a wide line through the center of the arena with ice, dealing high damage and freezing anyone caught in it. The boss will swoop twice before the fog disperses. Players should run around the edge of the arena until they see the dragon and its telegraph, which will only appear when they are close enough. Getting hit inflicts a vulnerability up Vulnerability Up stack and traps you in an ice block.
Move away from Kelpie to avoid outer edge damage.
Move to Kelpie to avoid outer edge damage.
Target players for AoE and tethered orbs. Spread puddles to avoid damage and debuffs and kite orbs away.
Large Circle AoE under random players.
The boss will become invulnerable and spawns 4 Subservient adds that must be destroyed to make the boss vulnerable and avoid high party damage.
Spawns 6 adds that must be destroyed using your Spriggan action ability to destroy adds. Spam action as necessary.
Goes to the middle of the arena and places a proximity marker there - Run to the edge.
Circle AoE attack from affected player - Move away from party.

The adds reactivate and move into a new pattern. They cannot be attacked. Odd pattern: Some adds target random players with line AoEs, while others damage the tank a few times. Even pattern: The adds form a horizontal or vertical line, splitting the arena in half. This is comboed with Citadel Buster.

The adds reactivate and move into a new pattern. They cannot be attacked. Odd pattern: Some adds target random players with line AoEs, while others damage the tank a few times. Even pattern: The adds form a horizontal or vertical line, splitting the arena in half. This is comboed with Citadel Buster.

Targets a random player with a large circle AoE that leaves behind a black puddle. Stepping in the puddle will cause it to detonate, dealing high damage and inflicting 40s of Heavy, after which it disperses. If the puddle gets detonated, the healer should help cleanse the debuffed player(s) so they can dodge upcoming mechanics.

The boss and adds join together with an orange tether and turn to face the same direction, then start charging a massive attack that hits half the arena. When the adds form a line after Electrochemical Transfer, go near the center of the arena in advance, then watch where they face to move behind to the safe half. It's important to do this quickly as halfway through the cast, the ground under the adds will turn into a brown line. Touching it will deal moderate damage, inflict a 60s vuln stack, and do massive knockback towards the direction you came from, so you can no longer cross once this line appears. If you still try to cross or are crossing when it appears, you will likely die to the charged attack unless you are healed up in time. This attack also inflicts 20s of uncleansable Damage Down.

The boss and adds join together with an orange tether and turn to face the same direction, then start charging a massive attack that hits half the arena. When the adds form a line after Electrochemical Transfer, go near the center of the arena in advance, then watch where they face to move behind to the safe half. It's important to do this quickly as halfway through the cast, the ground under the adds will turn into a brown line. Touching it will deal moderate damage, inflict a 60s vuln stack, and do massive knockback towards the direction you came from, so you can no longer cross once this line appears. If you still try to cross or are crossing when it appears, you will likely die to the charged attack unless you are healed up in time. This attack also inflicts 20s of uncleansable Damage Down.
Targets a random player with an untelegraphed line AoE, inflicting a 60s vuln stack. Dodge to the side of where the boss is facing.

Tethers to one of the green projections of Warring Triad primals outside the arena, absorbing it and mimicking its abilities temporarily. Each can only be absorbed once, after which its projection disappears. The primal's name will be mentioned in an NPC announcement. Sephirot: Targets all players with green AoE markers. When they go off (Ratzon), they place an expanding green orb under each player. Touching these orbs will repeatedly deal light damage and inflict a 60s vuln stack. Try to place these markers near the edge of the arena and not too far apart, to maximize the safe area you have left once the orbs expand. The boss uses Citadel Buster twice during this. Sophia: Targets a random player with a shrinking black ring marker and another with a similar white ring. These players must stay stacked as the rings finish shrinking to cancel out their effects. Doing so successfully will show black text stating "Equilibrium between sin and punishment maintained.". Otherwise, the black ring inflicts 20s of Reduced Immunity (Dischordant Cleansing) and the white ring inflicts 20s of Bleeding. This occurs twice, the second time targeting the other two players who have not yet been marked. The boss uses Ceruleum Vent followed by Citadel Buster twice during this. Zurvan: Afflicts two players with File:InfiniteFireZurvan.png Infinite Fire and two with File:InfiniteIceZurvan.png Infinite Ice. A fire meteor (Southern Star) and an ice meteor (Northern Star) then start slowly descending on opposite sides of the arena. All players should stand under the meteor that matches their debuff (fire with fire, ice with ice). Doing so cleanses the debuff, with black text stating "The seal is broken! Infinity fades...". Failing to soak the correct meteor instead inflicts 12s of File:InfiniteAnguishZurvan.png Infinite Anguish. If a meteor is not correctly soaked by at least one player, it will explode, dealing moderate raidwide damage and inflicting a 60s vuln stack. The boss uses Ceruleum Vent during this.

Each can only be absorbed once, after which its projection disappears. The primal's name will be mentioned in an NPC announcement. Sephirot: Targets all players with green AoE markers. When they go off (Ratzon), they place an expanding green orb under each player. Touching these orbs will repeatedly deal light damage and inflict a 60s vuln stack. Try to place these markers near the edge of the arena and not too far apart, to maximize the safe area you have left once the orbs expand. The boss uses Citadel Buster twice during this. Nearing the end of the cast, the arrow will stop, but "slip" four more times until it stops on the next safe area, at which point the Unknown will blast that area with a narrow cone while the orbs explode. To avoid being hit by this attack, watch where the arrow briefly stopped first before it begun to "slip". If you see that it stopped on safe spot before your own, then it will "slip" and hit to where you are. While the arrow is "slipping" it still safe to move, therefore, make your way to another spot before the circles AoE detonate.

Griaule will move to the center of the arena and summon five untargetable Painted Sapling adds that will then tether to him. These tethers can and should be intercepted by players, and after a short time, the adds will bestow a the Growing buff to whomever they were tethered to. To "intercept", a player needs to stand between the Painted Sapling and Griaule, to break the beam's line-of-sight to the boss. If successful, the beam will visually switch from Griaule to the player, and player will receive Growing buff. The Growing buff increases damage dealt and reduces damage taken, along with physically increasing the target's size. Players who gain a second stack of Growing will have it replaced with Full-Grown, which further increases the benefits gained from Growing, but the boss will continue to gain stacks. WARNING: If Growing buff is allowed to reach 5 stacks on Griaule, then the next Tiiimbeeer will instantly wipe the party even at full health.

Four Painted Ivy adds will appear at the feet of each player and inflict Fetter, thus rooting/binding them in place. The adds need to be targeted and destroyed to remove the debuff. The melee or short-range players can target their own add to break free, while ranged could help free other players from range, after freeing themselves. If not freed, the player will remained rooted/bound indefinitely and won't be able to move out of other attacks, such as Swinge.

Aenc Thon will move to the back of the arena, knock all players back to the entrance of the arena, and creates a massive gap in the center of the room. A single, narrow and winding path is the only way across the pit. Players that fall into the pit are teleported back to the start and stunned with Fool's Tumble, but are otherwise unharmed. Players' mobility and teleporation skills cannot be used to bypass the maze. At the same time, Aenc Thon will become surrounded in a barrier, summon the Liar's Lyre, and the two will begin casting Finale. If running the dungeon with the Trust system, each of the Scions will react differently to this: Thancred will run until the first turning point, at which point he'll jump across using using Rough Divide. Urianger will walk to the edge of the pit, then stand still and wait for someone else to make it across, at which point he'll cast Aetherial Manipulation to teleport himself to that person. Alisaie and Crystal Exarch use Sprint to run the whole thing without stopping. Y'shtola will also use Sprint, but to increase her walking speed, rather than running full-tilt. Minfilia and Alphinaud will cautiously and slowly walk. Alphinaud will eventually speed up, but Minfilia does not and will not make it to the end before Finale casts.
